notes: Mire Spray Deck, 2x2: a teal frame round a drain grate, four brass spray heads in the corners that throw arcs of water in turn onto a puddle in the middle (the 4-frame loop), a red hand-wheel in the middle of each edge. Off: a dry grate, heads dull. Damaged: one head hangs loose and sprays sideways, the frame is cracked. Disabled: the heads are snapped, the grate dark and dry.
